assumption_available_at_semantics: Hypothetical May 21 scenario effective time; retrospective market locator first-public availability is not established and cannot pass release review.
limitations: Built retrospectively on 2026-10-01; no May 21 frozen analyst forecast existed, so it is not an out-of-time backtest.
Some market locator observations have no verified first_public_at or rights; WACC is an illustrative screening assumption.
Reported USD GAAP net sales scenario is not a conversion of constant-currency or adjusted company guidance.

FY27 remaining sales growth of 3.05% on the FY26 comparable nine months gives approximately 4% full-year reported USD growth after the already-reported Q1; it is an analyst choice, not company guidance.
Future lease, FX, goodwill, restricted cash, deferred tax and share buyback changes are intentionally held static in this scenario without evidence they would be zero.
Historical total depreciation and amortization is used as modeled PPE depreciation; amortization of lease or other assets is not separately identified, so asset economics are incomplete.
FY27 year-end working-capital ratios applied to the seasonal April opening balances create a cash release; an observed FY27 year-end working-capital path is unavailable.
Interest driver uses net P&L interest as a proxy while the cash schedule treats it as paid; the difference from cash interest and finance lease classification is unresolved.
FCFF unlevered cash tax is an EBIT times 24% proxy, not jurisdictional cash tax evidence.
Current-date excess cash, nonoperating asset and other senior claim amounts are unknown; April 30 debt and NCI amounts are book balances and date-stale at the May 21 valuation date.
The terminal g/ROIC policy implies a material upward FCFF step from the final explicit year; its reinvestment transition is not evidenced.
The first forecast spans May 1-January 31, while dated DCF discounts its entire flow from May 21; unobserved May 1-20 cash realization is not separated.
